content.text: In Zimbabwe, where Stripe is blocked and local creators are locked out of digital commerce, building a digital store with free crypto payments requires a sovereign infrastructure. With platforms like PayPal and Gumroad unavailable, you need a robust solution that gives you control over your data and your business. COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack and Sovereign Starter Stack provide the answer, but understanding how to use Supabase as the order database is crucial. In this guide, we'll walk you through the process of setting up a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

When platforms like Stripe and PayPal fail or become unavailable, your business needs a robust infrastructure that can adapt. This is where COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack and Sovereign Starter Stack come in. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for payment verification, you can create a digital store that is not dependent on any single platform. This infrastructure is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that gives you control over your data and your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your digital store, you need to set up the necessary tools and infrastructure. This includes creating a GitHub or Cloudflare account, setting up a Supabase instance, and configuring your payment and delivery pipeline. You'll also need to download the Sovereign Blueprint, which provides complete documentation for all 5 stacks, full source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. This will help you understand how to integrate Supabase with NOWPayments and set up your payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your digital store. This involves configuring your payment gateway, setting up your delivery pipeline, and testing everything on the mainnet. With NOWPayments, you can integrate automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which eliminates the need for buyer accounts and reduces the risk of chargebacks. You'll also need to set up your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, which provides a secure and reliable way to deliver your digital products.

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. With NOWPayments, you can automatically verify payments on-chain, which reduces the risk of chargebacks and eliminates the need for buyer accounts.
